blocks.text: "Yes," replied Hadhrat Abu Usayd (RA). "To which tribe?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked further. Hadhrat Abu Usayd (RA) replied, "To the Banu Abs tribe." Rasulullaah ﷺ then instructed Hadhrat Abu Usayd (RA) saying, "Ride to them and bring him back yourself." [^1]
The Lecture of Hadhrat Umar (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) narrates that he was sitting with Hadhrat Umar (RA) one day when he heard a scream. Hadhrat Umar (RA) instructed his slave Yarfa to see where the noise was coming from. After checking, Yarfa reported, "The mother of a girl from the Quraysh is being sold (as a slave, because of which the child is screaming)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then instructed him to summon the Muhaajireen and the Ansaar. After a short while, the room and the entire house was filled. After praising Allaah, Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said: "Do you people know whether the severing of family ties was amongst the teachings that Rasulullaah ﷺ brought?" When they replied in the negative, Hadhrat Umar (RA) continued, "Because it has started to spread rapidly amongst you." He then recited the following verse of the Qur'aan:

blocks.arabic_text: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ اِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ اَنْ تُفْسِدُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوْٓا اَرْحَامَكُمْ
blocks.text: It is possible that if you are given authority (to rule over others), you would spread corruption on earth and (let alone harming others, you would even) sever family ties.

Hadhrat Umar (RA) continued, "What form of severing family ties is worse than selling the mother of a girl from amongst you when Allaah has given you abundance?" The Sahabah (RA) said, "Do as you see fit." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then wrote to all the regions (of the Islaamic Empire) instructing that the mother of no free woman should be sold (as a slave) because it entails severing family ties which is not permissible. [^2]
A Hadith of Abu Uthmaan Nahdi in this Regard

Hadhrat Abu Uthmaan Nahdi reports that after Hadhrat Umar (RA) had appointed a man from the Banu Asad tribe as governor, the man came to him to collect the certificate of appointment. In the meantime, one of Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s children was brought to him and he started kissing the child. The man from the Banu Asad tribe asked, "Do you kiss children, O Ameerul Mu'mineen? By Allaah! I have never kissed a child to this day." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "In that case, I swear by Allaah that you will be even less compassionate towards people. Give the certificate of appointment back. You should never act as governor for me ever again." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then cancelled his appointment. [^3]
